Container.Name: Stoat-Chat
Container.Overview:
Stoat (formerly Revolt) is a self-hosted, open-source chat platform - a privacy-focused alternative to Discord.
⚠️ IMPORTANT: This is a DOCKER COMPOSE application requiring multiple containers.
🌐 EASY SETUP WITH CONFIGURATION GENERATOR: Before installing, visit our configuration generator to easily set up your deployment: 👉 https://YOUR_USERNAME.github.io/stoat-unraid/config-generator.html
The generator will help you: • Choose between Public Domain or Tailscale VPN deployment • Configure all necessary settings • Generate secure credentials automatically • Provide step-by-step installation commands
✨ FEATURES: • Real-time messaging with WebSocket support • File uploads and attachments • Image and link previews • GIF search via Tenor (with API key) • Push notifications support • Full API access • Two deployment modes: Public or Private (Tailscale)
📋 DEPLOYMENT OPTIONS: 🌍 PUBLIC DOMAIN: Accessible from internet with your domain name 🔐 TAILSCALE VPN: Private access via Tailscale network (recommended for sharing with friends)
📋 REQUIREMENTS: • Docker Compose Manager plugin (install from Community Apps) • For PUBLIC: Domain name with DNS pointing to your server • For TAILSCALE: Tailscale account and auth key • 2GB+ RAM recommended
🚀 QUICK INSTALL: 1. Install "Docker Compose Manager" from Community Apps 2. Use the configuration generator (link above) to generate your setup 3. SSH into Unraid and follow the generated commands 4. Start with: docker compose up -d
📖 Full documentation: https://github.com/YOUR_USERNAME/stoat-unraid
Container.Requires:
⚠️ IMPORTANT SETUP INSTRUCTIONS:
This template provides the Stoat container but requires Docker Compose setup.
🌐 BEFORE INSTALLING - USE OUR CONFIGURATION GENERATOR: Visit: https://YOUR_USERNAME.github.io/stoat-unraid/config-generator.html
The generator will create all necessary configuration files and commands.
📋 MANUAL SETUP (if not using generator): 1. Install "Docker Compose Manager" from Community Apps 2. SSH into your Unraid server 3. Create directory: mkdir -p /mnt/user/appdata/stoat 4. Clone repo: git clone https://github.com/YOUR_USERNAME/stoat-unraid.git /mnt/user/appdata/stoat 5. Configure with: ./setup-unraid.sh your.domain.com 6. Start with: docker compose up -d
This template is provided for Community Apps compatibility but the actual deployment uses docker-compose.yml in your appdata directory.
